title: Storm claim replacement
summary: Hail-damaged 3-tab torn off to the deck, three OSB sheets replaced, code-compliant re-roof with architectural shingles. Written as an example of a Claude-authored plan.

steps.title: Pre-job walk and photos
steps.detail: Crew lead photographs every slope, marks hail hits with chalk, and confirms the material drop with the homeowner.

steps.title: Protect the property
steps.detail: Tarps over beds and the AC unit, plywood leaned against windows on the drip line, dumpster on plywood to protect the drive.

steps.title: Tear off to the deck
steps.detail: Shingles stripped from the ridge down. Each slope is dried in the same day it is opened.

steps.title: Strip felt and old fasteners
steps.detail: Old #15 felt and nails removed; protruding nails pulled so the new underlayment lies flat.

steps.title: Replace damaged sheathing
steps.detail: Three sheets of 7/16" OSB replaced where the deck was soft. Photos taken for the insurance supplement.

steps.title: Drip edge at the eaves
steps.detail: Drip edge fastened 12" o.c. along the eaves, below the ice & water shield.

steps.title: Ice & water shield
steps.detail: Two rows at the eaves to reach 24" inside the warm wall, and a full-width sheet centered in each valley.

steps.title: Synthetic underlayment
steps.detail: Rolled horizontally from the bottom up with 4" laps, cap nailed on the printed pattern.

steps.title: Drip edge at the rakes
steps.detail: Rake drip edge goes on over the underlayment so water cannot get behind it.

steps.title: Starter course
steps.detail: Starter strip on eaves and rakes with the sealant line at the edge for wind uplift.

steps.title: Shingles, course by course
steps.detail: 5-5/8" exposure, six nails per shingle on the nail line, offsets of at least 6".

steps.title: Ridge vent
steps.detail: Ridge cut open 1" each side, shingle-over vent nailed through its pre-marked holes.

steps.title: Hip & ridge cap
steps.detail: Cap shingles from the bottom of every hip up, then along the ridge away from the prevailing wind.

steps.title: Clean-up and final photos
steps.detail: Two magnetic sweeps, gutters flushed, final photo set uploaded to the claim.
